description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit disposal and landfill records with the manifests and facility record they answer to: each facility the facility record lists with its id, reference and name; each waste manifest with its id, manifest number, the quantity shipped and the moment shipped; each disposal entry with its id, reference, the manifest it disposes of, the facility, waste type, quantity disposed, the moment disposed and the dispose-by date the record states. The signed report gives the disposal entries and the records behind them, the quantity disposed against each manifest it names, each disposal entry against the manifest behind it, each entry’s facility against the facility record, and each disposal date against the dispose-by date the entry states, and counts them, and names divergent disposal records: a disposed quantity the manifest totals do not support, a disposal entry with no manifest behind it, waste recorded as disposed at a facility the facility record does not list, and disposal recorded past the date the record itself states; then a manifest with no disposal entry behind it and an entry stating a dispose-by date with no disposal date, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No disposal entries, no manifests beside disposal entries, or no facility record beside entries that name a facility leaves those points unverified. Manifests and facilities match by letters and digits, quantities read to the hundredth, more disposed against a manifest than it ships is unsupported, and dates read by the day. This reads whether every landfill and disposal entry rests on a manifest, at a listed facility, in the quantity shipped and by the date the record states. Verdict waste_disposal_record_divergent, waste_disposal_record_partial, waste_disposal_record_unverified or waste_disposal_record_consistent. POST /api/waste-disposal-record-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
